title: QlikView Task Reload Duration p95
app: QlikView Publisher/Distribution Service and Directory Service Connector logs via UF.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=qlikview:distribution result="Completed"
| eval dur_s=round(duration_s/1,2)
| stats avg(dur_s) as avg_s, p95(dur_s) as p95_s, count as runs by task_name
| where p95_s>600
| sort - p95_s
description: Computes the 95th-percentile reload duration for each task in QlikView and flags the slowest, pointing owners at the specific content or jobs that need optimisation.
value: Tail latency, not the average, is what users feel; ranking QlikView tasks by p95 focuses tuning effort where it removes the most pain.
implementation: Ingest QlikView timing data; schedule daily over a trailing week and review the slowest tasks with their owners.
visualization: Table of task by p95 reload duration, trend line.
grandmaExplanation: We measure how slow the worst cases are in QlikView so the sluggish ones get fixed before people give up on them.
